limitations: The 1330 intended source objects are verified against the explicit export-partitions list. Intentionally excluded archive/parent/LC-alpha objects are outside this export contract.
This validates binary geometry, embedded image bytes and references, not visual fidelity or runtime FPS.

resourceCostBreakdown.scope: Read-only exact encoded bufferView-byte SHA256 plus mode/filter/count/stride comparison; this is a theoretical reuse estimate, not a claim that runtime caches automatically share GLB buffers.
resourceCostBreakdown.finding: Large campus planting chunks contain no embedded images. Identical compressed geometry is repeated across spatial planting chunks, up to 11 files for the same view. Most total-size growth comes from geometry copies rather than image duplication.
